title: Preserve critical environmental excursions across asymmetric limits
prompt:
Fix lost critical warnings in the facility-readiness environmental evaluator. Change only lib/ohworks-environmental-monitoring.ts and add tests/ohworks-environmental-critical-severity.test.ts. Evidence: lib/ohworks-environmental-monitoring.ts:265 derives excursion severity solely from worstValue, while lines 379-381 retain the value with greatest absolute deviation from the acceptable band. For asymmetric critical limits, greatest deviation is not greatest severity. Reproduced with acceptable temperature 15 through 25, criticalBelow=14, criticalAbove=100, and consecutive readings 14 then 30 one minute apart: the excursion becomes minor and the room reports zero critical excursions despite a critical reading.

Track the highest severity observed throughout each open excursion independently from its greatest-deviation value. Initialize severity on opening, promote it whenever any subsequent reading is critical, and use that accumulated severity when closing. Preserve worstValue's existing greatest-deviation meaning, duration calculations, independent room/metric grouping, and tie-breaking rules. Keep the change local to this evaluator.

Test critical-low then minor-high readings, the reverse ordering, equal-deviation opposite-side readings, and a minor-only control. Assert excursion severity, critical/minor room counts, and worstExcursion severity, plus unchanged worstValue semantics. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks-environmental-critical-severity.test.ts. Planner reproduction succeeded; the six relevant existing suites passed 140 tests. Open PRs and recent merges contain no overlapping work. work on the assigned branch you are on. Use fabricated data and edit only the two named files; no external operations.
